A '''clone trooper''' was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] that [[Second Battle of Xagobah|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During the ensuing conflict against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], the Republic forces, including the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], besieged [[Mazariyan]], the citadel of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]]. When the Separatists counterattacked, the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was struck and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] from a [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droid]].

==Biography==
[[File:Xagobah.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The trooper traveled with his task force to the planet Xagobah (pictured).]]
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="BF:ANT" /> the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to fight for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="BF:ANT" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched a [[Task force/Legends|strike force]] to [[Second Battle of Xagobah|conquer]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] was part of this task force, which laid siege on [[Mazariyan]] citadel, a living-structure that was [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineered]] together with [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] Xagobah lifeforms. The citadel was commanded by [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] and key Separatist figure [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]].<ref name="BF:ANT" />

The trooper and the Republic forces bombarded Mazariyan from dug-in positions 500 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away from the citadel, but the attack had very little effect due to the healing abilities of the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. After some [[Time/Legends|time]], Tambor launched a counterattack, sending hundreds of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]], and [[spider droid]]s to engage the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] about 200 meters away from the citadel walls. The clone was part of the troops who engaged the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and, like his comrades, broke formation upon engaging the enemy. [[Standard second|Seconds]] into the fighting, the trooper was hit by a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] fired by a Hailfire droid and [[Death/Legends|killed]] upon impact. His death was witnessed by the young [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was looking for a way inside the fortress to capture Tambor.<ref name="BF:ANT" />

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett,<ref name="BF:ANT" /> the trooper stood 1.83 meters tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
During the siege of the Mazariyan, the trooper wore [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]].<ref name="BF:ANT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[2004]] young readers novel ''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]'', which was written by [[Elizabeth Hand]].<ref name="BF:ANT" />
